def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = remaining >= 0
    priority_scores[valid_mask] = bins[valid_mask] * np.exp(-remaining[valid_mask])
    return priority_scores

    remaining = bins - item
    valid = remaining >= 0
    # For valid bins, priority is higher when remaining is smaller (negative so that larger number = higher priority)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    remaining = bins - item
    priorities = np.zeros_like(bins)
    perfect_fit = remaining == 0
    fits = remaining > 0
    overflows = remaining < 0
    
    priorities[perfect_fit] = 1.0
    priorities[fits] = 0.5 - remaining[fits] / (2 * np.max(remaining[fits]) if np.any(fits) else 1)
    priorities[overflows] = -np.abs(remaining[overflows])
    
    return priorities

    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    mask = remaining >= 0
    # Compute utilization after adding item
    new_utilization = (bins[mask] + item) / bins[mask]
    # Higher utilization means higher priority; use negative to invert sorting
    priorities[mask] = -(new_utilization - 1.0) + (bins[mask] / bins.max()) * 1e-10
    return priorities

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    priority_scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    fit_mask = bins >= item
    if np.any(fit_mask):
        remaining = bins[fit_mask] - item
        diff = np.abs(remaining - item)
        priority_scores[fit_mask] = -diff + bins[fit_mask] * 1e-10
    return priority_scores

    priorities = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)

        diff = np.abs(item - 0.5 * bins[mask])
        priorities[mask] = -diff * 1_000_000 + bins[mask]
